description: Admin creates a staff user who can then sign in
steps: POST /api/v1/admin/users with valid body
Assert 201 and hash stored; log in as the new user

description: Invalid new user and duplicate username are rejected
steps: POST invalid usernames, weak password, prospect role
Assert 422 naming the field; duplicate gives 409 USERNAME_TAKEN

description: Admin changes a role and the change applies to issued tokens
steps: PUT role for a user holding a token
Assert the old token acts with the new role

description: Deactivated user cannot sign in and existing token stops working
steps: POST deactivate
Assert login 401 generic and old token 401; reactivate restores

description: Admins cannot modify themselves; last active admin is protected
steps: Admin deactivates or demotes own account
Assert 409 SELF_MODIFICATION; service refuses LAST_ADMIN

description: User management is audited without secrets and admin-only
steps: Create, change role, deactivate, reactivate
Assert audit rows hold ids and roles only; non-admin roles get 403, anonymous 401

description: Users page lists, creates, changes role, deactivates and hides own-row controls
steps: Open Users as admin
Create a user, change role, deactivate and reactivate
Assert no controls on own row; axe has no serious violations

description: Admin lists latest checklist version per product
steps: GET /api/v1/admin/checklists
Assert Savings, Current, NRE with items and created_at

description: Admin appends a new checklist version; old cases keep theirs
steps: POST /api/v1/admin/checklists/Savings
Assert version 2; earlier case still version 1; new case version 2

description: Invalid checklists are rejected and append nothing
steps: POST empty, missing baseline, duplicate, unknown class or item
Assert 422 and no new template row; unknown product 404

description: Checklist changes are audited and admin-only
steps: Publish a version
Assert CHECKLIST_VERSION_CREATED audit row; non-admin 403

description: Checklists page edits items and publishes a new version
steps: Open Checklists as admin
Untick mandatory photograph and assert validation error
Edit classes, publish, assert new prospects see them

description: Analyst raises a query on a case
steps: POST /api/v1/cases/{id}/queries as analyst
Assert 201 OPEN; validation 422; terminal case 409 CASE_LOCKED

description: Owner and staff list queries; other prospects cannot
steps: GET queries as owner, staff and another prospect
Assert 200, 200, 403 and oldest first

description: Prospect answers a query and closed queries refuse answers
steps: POST response as owner
Assert ANSWERED; closed query 409 QUERY_CLOSED; unknown query 404

description: Analyst closes a query once
steps: POST close twice
Assert CLOSED then 409 QUERY_CLOSED

description: Query history is append-only and PII-safe
steps: Raise, answer, close
Assert UPDATE/DELETE rejected; audit and logs hold ids, never message text

description: Raise and close are analyst-only; answering is prospect-only
steps: Call each route as every role and anonymously
Assert 401 for anonymous and 403 outside the matrix

description: Analyst raises and closes queries; prospect replies on the status page
steps: Analyst raises a query on a case
Prospect sees it and replies
Analyst sees ANSWERED and closes; reply form disappears

description: Prospect sign-up creates only a prospect account with a hashed password
steps: POST /api/v1/auth/signup with valid credentials
Assert 201, role prospect, case_id null, hash stored, audit USER_SIGNED_UP

description: Sign-up rejects invalid input and taken usernames including staff names
steps: POST invalid usernames and passwords, then admin1
Assert 422 naming the field and 409 USERNAME_TAKEN

description: A role in the sign-up body cannot create staff
steps: POST signup with role admin
Assert role prospect and 403 on every admin and staff route

description: A signed-in prospect registers a lead linked to the account; a second lead is refused
steps: POST /api/v1/leads with the account token
Assert case linked, token case-bound; second lead 409 CASE_EXISTS; anonymous leads still work

description: Login returns the linked case and a token bound to it
steps: Log in as the prospect account before and after registering
Assert case_id null then the case id; other cases 403

description: Prospect-account tokens die with the account and forged ones are rejected
steps: Deactivate the account; use a forged prospect token for an unknown user
Assert login and token 401; anonymous case tokens unaffected

description: Sign-up and unified sign-in pages redirect by role
steps: Open /signup and /login
Assert validation, taken-username message, links, demo accounts in dev, redirect per role

description: Customer, compliance officer and admin journey works end to end with RBAC
steps: Customer signs up, applies, reaches manual review
Officer signs in, approves; customer signs in and sees the account
Customer blocked from staff pages; admin lists the account without controls; deactivation ends the session

description: A requested staff role at sign-up is pending approval with no token
steps: POST /api/v1/auth/signup with role compliance-officer
Assert status PENDING_APPROVAL, no token, account inactive and pending; unknown role is 422

description: A pending account gets a clear message and no access
steps: Log in with the correct password
Assert 403 ACCOUNT_PENDING; wrong password stays generic 401; pending admin counts as no admin

description: Admin approves or rejects staff requests; audited and admin-only
steps: POST approve (optionally with another staff role) and reject
Assert activation, USER_APPROVED/USER_REJECTED audit, 409 NOT_PENDING otherwise, 403 for non-admins

description: Sign-up page asks the account type and staff requests show a confirmation
steps: Open /signup and choose Compliance officer
Assert the approval note, the Request account button and the confirmation instead of a session

description: Admin approves a pending request in the Users page and the requester can then sign in
steps: Request an account, see the pending message at sign-in
Admin approves in Users; the requester reaches the review queue

description: REVIEW_POLICY=auto keeps AC-07 auto-approval by default
steps: Decide a clean LOW-risk case with the default policy
Assert APPROVED with AUTO_APPROVED and an account

description: REVIEW_POLICY=manual routes every clean case to a compliance officer
steps: Submit a clean LOW-risk case on a manual-policy backend
Assert MANUAL_REVIEW with MANUAL_POLICY, no account, queue entry; specific reasons keep precedence

description: The officer decision completes a manual-policy case
steps: Officer approves with DOCS_CONFIRMED
Assert APPROVED and a stubbed account; reject creates none; only the officer may decide

description: Manual-policy journey: customer waits, officer approves, customer has an account
steps: Customer applies with a clean profile and sees the compliance-review message
Officer sees MANUAL_POLICY in the queue and approves
Customer signs in and sees the account

description: Admin sign-up needs approval by default (ADMIN_SIGNUP=approval)
steps: GET /api/v1/auth/signup-options on a default server
POST signup with role admin
Assert admin_requires_approval true and a pending response with no token

description: ADMIN_SIGNUP=open creates an active admin at sign-up while analyst and officer still wait
steps: POST signup with role admin on an open server
Assert ACTIVE, token and admin access; analyst and officer requests stay pending; unknown setting fails fast

description: Sign-up page tells the truth about approval for each role and opens the dashboard for an open admin sign-up
steps: Open /signup on an open server and pick Admin, KYC analyst, Compliance officer
Assert notes and button labels; admin lands on the dashboard

description: A self-registered admin can approve pending analyst and officer requests
steps: Sign up as admin, sign in again
Approve analyst and officer requests in Users; the officer reaches the review queue

description: Owner and every staff role can open an uploaded file with the right type and safe headers
steps: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}/documents/{doc}/file as owner, analyst, officer and admin
Assert 200, exact bytes, stored content type, nosniff, no-store and a name without the uploaded file name

description: Other customers, anonymous callers and unknown documents are refused
steps: Request a file as another prospect, with no token, with an unknown id and with another case id
Assert 403, 401 and 404

description: Every file view is audited by id only and never logged by name
steps: Open a document as staff and owner
Assert DOCUMENT_VIEWED rows with document_id and version only; no file name in audit or logs; document records unchanged

description: Replaced versions are listed in the evidence and stay openable by staff
steps: Re-upload a document
Assert evidence lists both versions with superseded flags and both files open

description: Analyst case page and officer review panel show a View button per document and an earlier-versions table
steps: Open a case as analyst and as officer
Assert View buttons; clicking fetches the file with the token and opens a new tab; errors show next to the button

description: Live: analyst and officer open the customer documents and the bytes match what was uploaded
steps: Seed a case with documents; analyst opens ID and address proof; officer opens documents of a review case
Assert the fetched blob contains the uploaded content and type; another customer gets 403
